text:
Make a brand-new account and finish Tutorial Island. Log in as "islander2" (password "islander2"); unknown usernames are registered automatically.

Every game action must go through `mcp__mors__execute_code` (TypeScript with `sdk` in scope); use `get_state` and `screenshot` to look.
state.tutorialProgress is the current step; game messages give the next instruction. You are done when tutorialProgress is 1000 and you are in Lumbridge (~3222,3218). Take a screenshot at the end and report.

Step reference (tutorialProgress -> what to do next):
1 talk to Gielinor Guide · 3 open Settings tab · 7 talk to Gielinor Guide · 10 house door (3098,3107) · 20 talk to Survival Expert · 40 net shrimp at a Fishing spot · 50 open Skills tab · 70 chop a Tree · 80 light a fire (use Tinderbox on Logs) · 90 cook shrimp on the fire (use Raw shrimps on Fire) · 120 survival gate (~3089,3092) · 130 chef door (3079,3084) · 140 talk to Master Chef · 150 make bread dough (use Pot of flour on Bucket of water) · 160 bake bread on Range (3075,3081) · 170 chef exit door (3072,3090) · 210 Quest Guide door (3086,3126) · 220 talk to Quest Guide · 230 open Quest List tab · 240 talk to Quest Guide · 250 Ladder down (3088,3119) · 260 talk to Mining Instructor · 300 mine Tin rocks · 310 mine Copper rocks · 320 smelt a bronze bar at the Furnace (3078,9495; use ore on furnace) · 330 talk to Mining Instructor · 350 smith a bronze dagger at an Anvil (use Bronze bar on Anvil, then pick the dagger) · 360 gate to combat area (3094,9503) · 370 talk to Combat Instructor · 390 open Equipment tab · 405 wield Bronze dagger · 410 talk to Combat Instructor · 420 wield sword and shield · 430 open Combat Options tab · 440 rat pen gate (3111,9518) · 450 kill a Giant rat (melee) · 470 talk to Combat Instructor (leave the pen first) · 480 wield shortbow + arrows and kill a rat with ranged · 500 Ladder up (3111,9526) · 510 use the Bank booth · 525 door to Account Guide (3125,3124) · 530 talk to Account Guide · 531 open Account Management tab · 532 talk to Account Guide · 540 door (3130,3124) · 550 talk to Brother Brace · 560 open Prayer tab · 570 talk to Brother Brace · 580 open Friends List tab · 600 talk to Brother Brace · 610 chapel door (3122,3102) · 620 talk to Magic Instructor (~3141,3088) · 630 open Magic tab · 650 cast Wind Strike on a Chicken (click the spell widget with option "Cast", then the chicken) · 670 talk to Magic Instructor and choose to go to the mainland.

Rules: play like a normal player on the real game. Only use normal game actions (walk, click NPCs/objects/items/widgets, dialogue keys, camera). Do NOT type "::" server commands or teleport — they are disabled and count as cheating. If a door says "I can't reach that", find another way in (e.g. the bank is entered through the large double doors on its south side).

Tips: after each step re-read get_state (tutorialProgress, messages, ui). Write snippets that do a whole step and verify it. If an interaction fails, look at the error text and nearby objects/npcs and adapt (e.g. walk closer, use exact names from state). Use sdk.client.act("menu") to see what the current right-click menu offers.

The new account "islander2" (password "islander2") has finished Tutorial Island. The tutorial progress value (varp 281) reads 1000, and the character is in Lumbridge at 3222,3218. The final screenshot shows the chatbox saying "Welcome to Lumbridge! You have completed the tutorial."

It's combat level 11 and has the starter kit: bronze tools, sword, shield, shortbow and arrows, dagger, and runes. I used only normal game actions: walking, clicking NPCs, objects, items and spells, dialogue keys and the camera. No `::` commands or teleports. I left the tutorial through the Magic Instructor's "Yes, take me to the mainland."

Things that went wrong along the way:
- **Clicks not landing:** most failed clicks happened because the camera was facing the wrong way. Turning it toward the target and retrying fixed them.
- **Burnt shrimp:** the tutorial counted the burnt one, so cooking still moved on.
- **Rat pen:** I got stuck inside after the melee kill. I had to leave through the gate and walk around the fence to reach the Combat Instructor.
- **Ranged kill not counting:** it only registered after I dismissed the level-up messages.
- **Wind Strike:** I checked that the spell was selected before clicking the chicken, so I didn't hit Home Teleport by accident. That mistake ruined the first "islander" account.

Memory is updated. I added `playing/islander2/CLAUDE.md` and put the Tutorial Island lessons in `playing/CLAUDE.md`: fixing the camera, the inventory tab and bank window problems, how the gates move you, and the last dialogue step.
